name: How do I maintain my tile backsplash after installation?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my tile backsplash after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining your tile backsplash involves regular cleaning and, for some materials, periodic sealing. For most ceramic and porcelain tiles, a mild cleaner and a soft cloth are sufficient to wipe away splashes and grime. Natural stone tiles, however, are porous and require sealing upon installation and typically annually thereafter to prevent staining and moisture absorption. Avoid abrasive cleaners or harsh chemicals, which can damage grout and tile surfaces. Hometelligent Inc. provides specific care instructions tailored to the materials used in your installation to ensure its lasting beauty.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain your backsplash with regular cleaning using mild cleaners. Natural stone tiles require periodic sealing. Avoid abrasive chemicals to protect tile and grout.
